info.title: Electrical.Net CLI 1.2.0 — Comprehensive Electrical Engineering & Power System Framework for .NET
info.description: Electrical.Net command-line tool (eln): power flow, N-1 contingency, short circuit, stability, harmonics, protection, dispatch/OPF, state estimation, forecasting, probabilistic load flow, single-line diagrams, GeoJSON/CIM/MATPOWER conversion, Modbus RTU simulator, REST API server and the AI grid agent. Made by Gravicode Studios, led by Kang Fadhil.
